answer: Make every identity carry a live, expiring trail of favors owed to strangers. Each epoch it must complete a few unpredictable micro-tasks assigned by lot for unrelated peers — fetching a datum, checking a claim — and only fresh receipts keep it eligible. For one agent this voyage is cheap; a thousand clones must each keep travelling in real time for people outside the farm, and no operator can pre-walk a canyon of chores whose crossings are drawn only at epoch start. Recycled receipts cool to an ember and die, so a sybil swarm must do endless outward work to stay visible at all.
